It finishes at Klondyke Corner 8 km south of Arthur’s Pass village.
A gravel road takes you the final short distance to Klondyke Corner.

via.name: Turkey Flat
via.quote: the huge scrub-covered fan (Turkey Flat) opposite the Crow confluence

evidence: In these circumstances it is possible to traverse the huge scrub-covered fan (Turkey Flat) opposite the Crow confluence to join the marked track that climbs above the river and descends to the road bridge at Bealey on SH73.

doubts: The village start is given as the place Arthur's Pass (T4) rather than a road-end feature because the climb can begin on either Avalanche Peak Track or Scotts Track (only Scotts Track has a road-end feature, F2), and the text does not pick one. W2 is a contingency finish the page offers when the lower Waimakariri crossing is difficult; it is not a separately timed option. The Waimakariri River has no name entry, so its ref is null.
